name: fixture-10-react-quill
comment: react-quill@2.0.0 is a real, widely-used (now unmaintained) npm package whose Transition/editor wrapper calls ReactDOM.findDOMNode(this.editingArea) internally (verified: lib/index.js). Its declared peerDependencies cap react/react-dom at ^18, which is why this repo's root .npmrc sets legacy-peer-deps=true — without it `npm install` would ERESOLVE-fail before this fixture could even demonstrate the React 19 failure it exists to show.
